rationale: Adds the agent-toolkit template under tools/templates, which the design-output-and-packaging family claims by its tools/templates selectors. The change adds one new built-in template for pulp create (a synth that binds the agent tool kit operations and builds as a Standalone) plus its tests; the design-import templates (from-figma, from-v0) and everything under tools/import-design are untouched, and no Chromium, rendering, design-import or packaging authority moves.
